acceptance_criteria.cycles: 0 cycles in internal moneymin import graph (import-cycle count).
acceptance_criteria.http_routes: Each extracted route belongs to exactly one domain blueprint/module; route method+path inventory remains unchanged during extraction.
acceptance_criteria.request_context: No request/g/current_app access from background workers or module import time; route handlers pass immutable request data to services.
acceptance_criteria.factory_state: create_app has no mutable process-wide state changed per factory invocation; app-specific services are in app.extensions or explicit dependencies.
acceptance_criteria.monkeypatch_compatibility: All legacy server symbols used as patch points resolve at handler invocation time through an explicit compatibility dependency adapter; no exec/eval/inject_globals and no captured copies of patchable symbols.
acceptance_criteria.registry_contract: Provider registry has unique stable IDs, explicit capabilities and adapters; campaign/upload persistence keys and sent-registry semantics stay stable.
acceptance_criteria.function_size: New route/service functions <=100 LOC; existing functions >200 LOC are decomposed into named, single-purpose units unless an invariant makes that unsafe and the exception is documented.
acceptance_criteria.desktop_boundary: MainWindow owns shell/navigation and delegates page behavior; HTTP/process integration goes through named clients/services, no page reaches across another page's widgets.
acceptance_criteria.init_races: Background workers do not start until app state and extension services are initialized; repeated create_app calls and concurrent startup tests prove this contract.
acceptance_criteria.measured_progress: Report counts and exceptions by domain; do not claim zero coupling. Cross-domain dependencies must be explicit and documented.
